report:
### Screen: `products--slug-390` (390px)
- **Extra `HomeTopInfo` banner:** The preview renders a green pill button “Get your free peptide safety test →” below the nav links. The mobile design does **not** contain this element; only the full-width top banner is present.
- **Breadcrumbs visible:** The preview shows “Products / Retatrutide” breadcrumbs above the page title. The mobile design omits breadcrumbs entirely.
- **Methodology badge container style:** The preview shows an unbordered gray-background container for the methodology pills and places “View methodology” on the same baseline. The design uses a white, bordered outline container with a dropdown arrow, and “View methodology” is on its own line below the container.
- **Product subtitle copy:** The preview reads “methodology · Purity Focused” (capital F, extra “ed”). The design reads “methodology · Purity focus” (lowercase f, no “ed”).
- **Customer filter missing star icon:** The design shows a star (★) inside the “Customer” filter dropdown; the preview shows only the text “Customer” with a chevron.
- **Missing vendor rows:** The vendors panel displays an error fallback (“Unable to load vendors…”) instead of the eight vendor card rows shown in the design.
- **Missing test-history rows:** The test-history panel displays an error fallback instead of the populated table rows.
- **COA-backed badge icon:** The preview uses a document/page icon before “COA-BACKED LAB TESTS”. The design uses a small green dot (●).

### Screen: `products--slug-744` (744px)
- **Extra `HomeTopInfo` banner:** The preview renders the green pill banner below the nav links. The tablet design does not include this element.
- **Vendor table header text transform:** Preview headers are uppercase: “VENDOR”, “$/MG”, “CUSTOMER RATING”, “PURITY RATING”. The design uses title/normal case: “Vendor”, “$/mg”, “Customer Rating”, “Purity Rating”.
- **Customer filter missing star icon:** Same star (★) omission as mobile.
- **Methodology badge container style:** The preview uses a gray-background rounded container. The design uses a white, bordered outline container with a dropdown arrow.
- **Product subtitle copy:** Same casing discrepancy as mobile (“Purity Focused” vs “Purity focus”).
- **Missing vendor and test-history rows:** Error fallbacks are visible instead of populated data.
- **COA-backed badge icon:** Document icon in preview vs green dot in design.
- **Footer copyright alignment:** The preview left-aligns “©2026 Peptrace”. The design centers it at the bottom of the footer.

### Screen: `products--slug-1440` (1440px)
- **Vendor table header text transform:** Same uppercase vs title-case discrepancy as tablet.
- **Customer filter missing star icon:** Same star omission.
- **Methodology badge container style:** Same gray-background vs bordered-outline discrepancy; the design also includes a dropdown arrow that is absent in the preview.
- **Product subtitle copy:** Same “Purity Focused” vs “Purity focus” discrepancy.
- **Missing vendor and test-history rows:** Error fallbacks visible instead of data.
- **COA-backed badge icon:** Document icon in preview vs green dot in design.
- **Footer copyright alignment:** Preview left-aligns the copyright; the design centers it.
